name: bench-supported-dumbbell-external-rotation
instructions:
1. Assume a standing position behind an adjustable bench with the bench completely upright.
2. Position the elbow on the bench with the forearm parallel to the body.
3. Externally rotate at the shoulder until the forearm is almost completely upright.
4. Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
starting_position: 1. Assume a standing position behind an adjustable bench with the bench completely upright. 2. Position the elbow on the bench with the forearm parallel to the body.
